## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmed by weak overall sector breadth (≤4/11) and both Financials and Industrials negative; leadership concentration: Narrow (3/5 Technology). Major divergence present (≥3 large-cap names showing 1W vs 1M flips) — transitional risk, watch for trend breaks.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +4.87%) — Healthcare breadth: 12/17 positive (Sector Strength). Consumer Staples: MO ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.90% | 1M: +11.35%), MNST RECOVERY (1W: +4.04% | 1M: -2.09%) — Staples breadth: 10/14 positive (Sector Strength).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -3.91%), CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -11.70% | 1M: -6.57%) — Utilities breadth: 1/10 positive (Sector Weakness). Financials weak: BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%) — Financials breadth: 4/20 positive (Sector Weakness). Technology showing internal damage: ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -14.92%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -14.76% | 1M: -21.70%) — Tech breadth: 6/24 positive (Sector Weakness).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +12.10% | 1M: -0.03%), ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%), ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +11.57%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.64% | 1M: +18.79%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — concentration risk amid a risk-off backdrop.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -3.91%), ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -14.92%), BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%), SLB BELOW TREND (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -2.39%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%). Weakness concentrated in Financials and Tech, amplifying the market’s defensive tone.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: PANW (1W: +12.10%), ISRG (1W: +8.22%), ACN (1W: +7.87%), TMO (1W: +7.14%). Watch for divergences: MSFT TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -0.27% | 1M: +2.26%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -0.26%), TSLA TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -2.65% | 1M: +5.53%) — tactical, not yet broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is weak with mixed leadership: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +8.78%) and QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +14.59%) contrast with ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -14.92%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.40% | 1M: -22.32%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -14.76% | 1M: -21.70%). Tech breadth: 6/24 positive (Sector Weakness); expect narrow leadership and higher volatility.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are showing weakness and dispersion: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -3.34%), BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%) versus V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +3.37%). Financials breadth: 4/20 positive (Sector Weakness); earnings/trading headlines are acting stock-specifically.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is the clearest defensive pocket: TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +4.87%), ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%). Healthcare breadth: 12/17 positive (Sector Strength); defensive accumulation vs market-wide risk-off.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor defensive exposure in Healthcare and Consumer Staples while reducing exposure to the weakest Financials and cyclical Tech names that are BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major divergence suggests tactical caution and monitoring for confirmed trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +8.78%), TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%). BEARISH: ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -14.92%), BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (12/17 positive) and Consumer Staples (10/14 positive) for defensive leadership and relative stability. BEARISH: Utilities (1/10 positive), Financials (4/20 positive) and Technology (6/24 positive) for ongoing downside risk and dispersion.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA BELOW TREND — watch for a failed bounce or consolidation as confirmation of tech weakness (1W: -4.26% | 1M: -4.83%). AAPL ABOVE TREND — continued outperformance vs peers would signal selective strength (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +8.78%). GS/BAC BELOW TREND — renewed breakdowns would deepen financials’ risk-off tone (GS 1W: -8.83% | 1M: -10.34%; BAC 1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ISRG (+75): EU approval for da Vinci SP expands TAM; price RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%) — sentiment confirms short-term accumulation. JPM (+50): Trading growth headlines; price BELOW TREND (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -3.34%) — positive news but price lagging, watch for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (-60): CEO caution on 737 production; BA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -10.62%) — sentiment confirms weakness. BAC (-50): fee guidance down; BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.91%) — sentiment and price aligned. QCOM (-45): negative narrative on Apple exposure; QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +14.59%) — bearish headlines but price showing divergence, monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, style mixed / no clear leadership. TMO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.83%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +8.78%), ISRG RECOVERY (1W: +8.22% | 1M: -2.06%) showing relative strength. Key risk: major large-cap divergences (MSFT, GOOGL, TSLA flips) and bearish sentiment in Financials/Industrials — wait for confirmation before adding cyclicals.
